facts.fact: The article reports the Master Plan for the Digitalization of Public Services (PDDSP 2023-2033) as noting the absence of verifiable digital ID systems in Burundi, and recommending an e-signature and authentication infrastructure.

BDI.note: Only says civil servants have limited digital skills; no training stated.

facts.fact: The article reports the PDDSP master plan as noting the absence of a Computer Incident Response Team in Burundi.

BDI.note: Only the absence of a National Data Center and a plan for one; no statement about data centres for hire.
Only a cybercrime law (Law No. 1/004 of 16 March 2022) is named; no data protection law stated.
Only low citizen digital awareness is mentioned; no training stated.

systems.system: Plan Directeur de Digitalisation des Services Publics (PDDSP 2023-2033)

BDI.note: The PDDSP is a strategy for digitalising public services, not a national digital strategy.
The plan only recommends priority legislation; no e-commerce law stated.
A national e-government framework is only recommended; no service stated.
Power cuts mentioned without a count.
Only the absence of verifiable digital ID systems; no statement of a national ID system's state.
Only the absence of a National Data Center and a plan for a National Integrated Data Center; nothing on data centres for hire.

facts.fact: The article says optic-fibre ISPs and satellite providers (Starlink, NT Global) drive Burundi's internet market.
